title: Suite test-generation config (bddsuite.tests.yaml)
description: One per test project, at its root. suiterun generate reads it to build the test plan (test-plan.md) and write test code for one test framework. Paths are relative to this file and use forward slashes.

suites.description: Globs of the files to consider. A matching file is a suite when its top level has a suite key; any other matching file (a library) is left out.

exclude.description: Globs of files never considered, even when suites matches them.

schemaRoot.description: The folder holding the workspace's actions.catalog.yaml and suite.schema.json, which suites are linted against before anything is generated.

provider.description: The test framework to generate for. Optional where the generator can detect it: C# from the project's package references, TypeScript from package.json; Go, Rust and PowerShell have one each.

extensions.description: The runtime extensions the generated run hook registers, named the way the language names them: a C# type, a Go import path and exported variable (path.Name), a Rust path to a function returning the extension, a TypeScript module specifier and export (module#name), a PowerShell module path.

offlineActions.description: Actions a suite may use without being guarded: names, or prefix.* patterns. A suite using any other action is guarded and its tests skip unless BDD_SUITE_ALLOW_GUARDED=1 (session.md, rule 9). Absent: no suite is guarded.

contextKeys.description: The context keys the extensions add (each read as ${key}). The generator lints every suite before any extension is loaded, so it learns them here; without them a suite that reads ${store} would be refused (E301).

output.description: Where and under what names the code is written. Every key is optional; each generator documents its defaults.

folder.description: The folder generated files go to. C# and Rust ignore it: they generate into the build's intermediate folder.

namespace.description: C#: the namespace of the generated classes.

package.description: Go: the package clause of the generated files (the test package's name).

host.description: C# mstest only: the host that runs the generated tests when it is not the MSTest runner. taef generates code TAEF's CoreCLR host can run: no fixture takes MSTest's TestContext, each suite opens on its first test, and the run's inputs come from the environment.

path.description: A path or glob relative to this file, with forward slashes.
